description: End-to-end workflow for identifying at-risk telecom customers, designing and booking targeted retention offers, and managing follow-up actions.

customer_id.description: Unique customer identifier in the telco CRM

account_id.description: Billing or service account identifier associated with a customer

retention_case_id.description: Identifier for a specific retention case/session

offer_id.description: Identifier for a predefined or dynamically generated retention offer

offer_quote_id.description: Identifier for a specific priced and validated offer instance for a customer

booking_id.description: Identifier for a scheduled activation/appointment related to a retention offer

agent_id.description: Identifier for a call center or retention specialist agent

audit_event_id.description: Identifier of an audit log entry.

subscription_id.description: Identifier of a webhook or notification subscription.

snapshot_id.description: Identifier of a captured state snapshot.

functions.name: search_at_risk_customers
functions.description: Search for at-risk customers based on churn scores, segments, and behaviors.

churn_score_min.description: Lower bound for churn probability score (0-1)

churn_score_max.description: Upper bound for churn probability score (0-1)

complaint_within_days.description: Number of days within which a complaint was logged

usage_drop_percent_min.description: Minimum percentage drop in usage compared to baseline

functions.returns: Paginated list of at-risk customers with basic risk indicators.

functions.name: create_retention_case
functions.description: Create a new retention case for a specific customer, capturing context and objectives.

initiated_by.description: Information about who initiated the case

agent_id.description: Agent ID if initiated by agent

reason.description: Reason for potential churn or retention engagement

detailed_reason.description: Free text description of the reason

target_outcomes.description: Business and customer outcomes aimed for this case

context.description: Additional context snapshot at case creation

functions.returns: New retention_case_id with initial case status and summary.

functions.name: get_retention_case
functions.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific retention case.
functions.returns: Retention case details including status, associated offers, and bookings.

functions.name: evaluate_retention_eligibility
functions.description: Evaluate a customer's eligibility for retention offers and recommend strategies.

evaluation_context.description: Contextual parameters that might influence eligibility

time_horizon_months.description: Time horizon to evaluate expected value

functions.returns: Eligibility result with allowed offer types, caps, and recommended retention strategy.

functions.name: search_retention_offers
functions.description: Search catalog and rule-based recommendations for suitable retention offers for a customer.

filters.description: Search filters for the retention offers

functions.returns: List of candidate retention offers with fit scores and brief financial impact.

functions.name: generate_offer_quote
functions.description: Generate a priced and validated offer quote for a specific customer, including fees, discounts, and contract terms.

configuration.description: Customization and configuration of the offer

selected_add_ons.description: Optional add-ons to include in the offer

device_option.description: Optional device component of the offer

discount_overrides.description: Requested discount overrides subject to approval

pricing_context.description: Context affecting pricing like taxes and region

functions.returns: offer_quote_id with detailed pricing breakdown, eligibility checks, and expiration timestamp.

functions.name: check_offer_availability
functions.description: Validate that a generated offer quote is still available and technically feasible at the time of booking.
functions.returns: Validation result with availability status, issues list, and any required changes.

functions.name: book_retention_offer
functions.description: Book and schedule the activation of a retention offer, optionally including technician appointments.

booking_details.description: Details of the booking and activation

requested_activation_date.description: Requested activation date/time for scheduled activations

consent.description: Customer consent details for new contract/offer

functions.returns: booking_id with booked activation/appointment details and initial booking status.

functions.name: get_booking_status
functions.description: Retrieve the current status and timeline of a retention offer booking.
functions.returns: Booking details, current status, and any upcoming steps or appointments.

functions.name: modify_booking
functions.description: Modify an existing retention booking, such as rescheduling appointment or changing activation date.

requested_changes.description: Fields that can be updated for the booking

agent_id.description: Agent performing the modification, if applicable

functions.returns: Updated booking details and status, or errors if modification not allowed.

functions.name: cancel_retention_booking
functions.description: Cancel a retention booking and optionally roll back associated technical and billing changes.

rollback_options.description: Controls which parts of the change should be rolled back

functions.returns: Cancellation confirmation, final booking status, and any rollback summary.

functions.name: retry_offer_activation
functions.description: Retry a failed retention offer activation, optionally with adjusted parameters.

resolved_root_cause.description: Indicates whether the root cause has been addressed

retry_strategy.description: Controls how the retry should be executed

technical_overrides.description: Optional adjustments to improve activation success

functions.returns: New or updated activation attempt details, status, and tracking identifiers.

functions.name: close_retention_case
functions.description: Close a retention case after completion or abandonment, recording outcomes and feedback.

associated_booking_id.description: Booking ID associated with the final outcome, if any

retention_value_estimate.description: Estimated retained lifetime value in account currency

functions.returns: Final retention case record with closure timestamp and summarized outcome metrics.

functions.name: search_customers
functions.description: Faceted search across customer records with rich filters, full-text query, and faceted aggregations for telco_retention_offer_booking.

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

highlight.description: Return highlighted snippets when matching text

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated result set of customer records with facet buckets, total count, and continuation cursor.

functions.name: list_customers_by_status
functions.description: List customer records filtered by lifecycle status with stable cursor pagination.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated list of customer records matching the requested statuses, optionally with summary metrics.

functions.name: get_customer_detail
functions.description: Fetch a single customer record with optional expansion of related entities and versioned snapshots.

as_of.description: Read the record as of this point in time

version_id.description: Specific version to retrieve when versioning is enabled

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A customer record with the requested expansions and version metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_customers
functions.description: Submit a batch of customer records for creation, with idempotency keys and partial-success reporting.

tags.description: Tags applied to the new record

trace_id.description: Correlation id propagated across the batch

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A per-item outcome list with created identifiers, validation errors, and batch-level statistics.

functions.name: bulk_update_customers
functions.description: Apply partial updates to many customer records in a single transactional batch.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

patch.description: JSON merge-patch applied to every matched record

dry_run.description: Compute affected count without applying changes

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Affected record count, sampled previews, and any per-record errors.

functions.name: bulk_archive_customers
functions.description: Soft-archive customer records matching a selector with optional grace period before purge.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

preserve_audit.description: Keep audit trail even after purge

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Archive operation summary including matched count, scheduled purge date, and any blockers.

functions.name: export_customers
functions.description: Asynchronously export a filtered slice of customer records to the configured object store.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

destination.description: Where the export should be delivered

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with status, destination URI, and progress callbacks.

functions.name: subscribe_customer_events
functions.description: Register a webhook subscription for customer lifecycle events with HMAC signing and replay protection.

filter.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

signing_secret_ref.description: Reference to the HMAC signing secret

tls_verify.description: Whether to validate the server certificate

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A subscription handle including subscription_id, verification status, and current delivery health.

functions.name: unsubscribe_customer_events
functions.description: Disable or delete a previously created customer event subscription.

drain_seconds.description: Grace period to flush in-flight events

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Final subscription state and any undelivered event counts at the time of termination.

functions.name: get_customer_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the chronological audit log for a customer including who changed what and when.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An ordered list of audit entries with diffs, actor metadata, and correlation ids.

functions.name: query_customer_changelog
functions.description: Query the cross-record changelog for telco_retention_offer_booking with field-level filters.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

fields_changed.description: Restrict to changes touching these fields

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregated changelog rows or detail entries depending on group_by, plus totals.

functions.name: schedule_customer_job
functions.description: Create a recurring or one-off scheduled job that runs a telco_retention_offer_booking operation.

operation.description: Operation name to invoke when the schedule fires

input_template.description: Parameters passed to the operation, with templating

failure_policy.description: What to do when a run fails

max_failures.description: Pause schedule after this many failures

alert_channel.description: Channel id to alert on failure

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A schedule descriptor including schedule_id, next run time, and validation issues.

functions.name: pause_customer_schedule
functions.description: Temporarily pause a scheduled telco_retention_offer_booking job without deleting its history.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated schedule status and prior pause history.

functions.name: simulate_customer_execution
functions.description: Run a dry-run simulation of a telco_retention_offer_booking execution path without producing side effects.

include_side_effect_plan.description: Return the side effects that would have been emitted

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Simulation transcript with predicted outcome, side-effect plan, and assertions checked.

functions.name: preview_customer_change
functions.description: Compute a preview of how a proposed change would affect a customer prior to commit.

evaluate_policies.description: Run policy engine against the proposed state

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A preview document with field diffs, policy verdicts, and dependency impact.

functions.name: submit_customer_for_approval
functions.description: Submit a customer for review with configurable approver routing and SLA targets.

approver_group.description: Group or role authorised at this step

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Approval workflow handle with approval_id, current step, and projected completion time.

functions.name: record_customer_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/recuse decision for a pending customer approval step.

conditions.description: Conditions attached to a conditional approval

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated approval state, next pending step, and any triggered automations.

functions.name: escalate_customer
functions.description: Escalate a stuck or breached customer to a higher tier with paging and audit.

target_team.description: Team or rota receiving the escalation

context_refs.description: Related artifact ids attached for context

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Escalation record id, paged responders, and acknowledgement timer.

functions.name: add_customer_comment
functions.description: Append a comment, optionally with @mentions and visibility scope, to a customer.

mentions.description: User ids mentioned in the body

parent_comment_id.description: Comment id this one replies to

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Newly created comment record including comment_id and resolved mentions.

functions.name: attach_customer_evidence
functions.description: Upload an evidence file or link as an attachment to a customer with content hash and retention.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Attachment descriptor including attachment_id, content hash, and stored URI.

functions.name: snapshot_customer_state
functions.description: Capture a point-in-time snapshot of a customer and its dependencies for restore or audit.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, captured size, and storage URI.

functions.name: restore_customer_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a customer (and optionally dependencies) from a previously captured snapshot.

new_owner_id.description: Owner of the restored record when mode=new_record

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Restore job descriptor with conflicts surfaced and final record id.

functions.name: get_customer_metrics_summary
functions.description: Compute summary KPIs for telco_retention_offer_booking over a time window with optional segmentation.

metrics.description: Metric names to compute (e.g. throughput, p95_latency, failure_rate)

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

compare_to_previous_period.description: Include delta vs the previous equal-length window

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A metrics document with per-bucket values, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: create_customer_dashboard
functions.description: Define a dashboard layout combining charts and tables for telco_retention_offer_booking.

query.description: Query spec, polymorphic by panel type

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Dashboard descriptor including dashboard_id and resolved share list.

functions.name: define_customer_policy
functions.description: Create or version a policy controlling allowed telco_retention_offer_booking behaviour.

rules.description: Ordered rule list, first match wins

when.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

enforcement_mode.description: How strictly the policy is applied

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Policy version descriptor with policy_id, version_id, and validation report.

functions.name: evaluate_customer_policies
functions.description: Evaluate the active telco_retention_offer_booking policies against a candidate input and return verdicts.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregate verdict, per-rule outcomes, and any obligations attached to the decision.

functions.name: link_customer_dependencies
functions.description: Declare typed dependency links between a customer and related artifacts to drive impact analysis.

replace_existing.description: Replace prior links of the same relations

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Resulting link set with created, updated, and removed entries.
